remarks: Welcome home to this thoughtfully updated 3 bed, 2 bath retreat just minutes from Joshua Tree National Park. Set among mature Joshua trees on the property, the home offers some of the most breathtaking, unobstructed views of the high desert and the San Gorgonio mountains, the kind of backdrop that makes every morning coffee and evening sunset feel like an event. Inside, polished concrete floors run throughout, staying cool through the summer heat, and the open living room is anchored by a wood-burning stove, creating a warm gathering place for cool desert nights.
